body:
Best Feeling
I have read the other experiences
online and I must say I strongly disagree with reports that these patches do not produce any kind of euphoric feeling.  I have used Oxycontin for about 3 years now, and have an extremely high tolerance for any kind of opiates.  I usually have to do between 80 and 100 mg of Oxy to produce a euphoric effect.  But these patches work wonders.  About a month ago I had been unable to obtain any opiates for around 5 days and was feeling withdrawal symptoms really bad.  Cold sweats, joint pain, vomiting, diahrea, could not sleep, it was great.  So finally, I got ahold of one 100 ug/h 10 mg fentanyl patch, and I was very skeptical about using it, I just didnt know if it would work or not.  I cut in into fourths and ate all of the gel out of one of the pieces and chewed on it for a good 5 minutes.  At first I felt nothing, and it did take a little time to come on.  It definitely crept up on
me.  After about 10-15 minutes I noticed that my pains were all gone, and I began to relax.  After about 20-25 minutes I began to get that nice warm feeling running up my spine and exploding in a tingling sensation all across my body.  Everything took on a nice rosy hue after that, I couldn't help but have a smile on my face, and it felt as if everything was right.  Complete euphoria.  This feeling lasted a couple of hours, or atleast until I fell asleep very peacefully that night.  The next morning I woke up in a great mood and went about my business still feeling fine.  So I believe these patches are great
for that euphoric feeling, the only downfall is that the onset takes a little longer than most opiates.
